answer: A sybil farmer's edge is free identities, so make each identity pay in work that can't be copied. To keep mining rights, an agent must tend one patch of a shared atlas: verifying fresh claims against hidden ground truth, each check a thin shale layer in a public record. A gale of random re-checks samples old layers; one failed layer collapses the stack above it. Ten sockpuppets must do ten patches of real verification — no multiplier, no free ride.
